class.name: OcgAISInteractivecontext
class.brief_description: The Interactive Context allows you to manage graphic behavior and selection of Interactive Objects in one or more viewers. Class methods make this highly transparent. It is essential to remember that an Interactive Object which is already known by the Interactive Context must be modified using Context methods. You can only directly call the methods available for an Interactive Object if it has not been loaded into an Interactive Context.
class.description: ! The Interactive Context allows you to manage graphic behavior and selection of Interactive ! Objects in one or more viewers. Class methods make this highly transparent. It is essential to ! remember that an Interactive Object which is already known by the Interactive Context must be ! modified using Context methods. You can only directly call the methods available for an ! Interactive Object if it has not been loaded into an Interactive Context. ! ! Each selectable object must specify the selection mode that is ! responsible for selection of object as a whole (global selection mode). ! Interactive context itself supports decomposed object selection with selection filters support. ! By default, global selection mode is equal to 0, but it might be redefined if needed.

method.name: AIS_InteractiveContext
method.description: Constructs the interactive context object defined by the principal viewer MainViewer.

method.name: DisplayStatus
method.description: Returns the display status of the entity anIobj. This will be one of the following: - AIS_DS_Displayed displayed in main viewer - AIS_DS_Erased hidden in main viewer - AIS_DS_Temporary temporarily displayed - AIS_DS_None nowhere displayed.

method.name: IsDisplayed_1
method.description: Returns true if Object is displayed in the interactive context.

method.name: SetAutoActivateSelection
method.description: Enable or disable automatic activation of default selection mode while displaying the object.

method.name: GetAutoActivateSelection
method.description: Manages displaying the new object should also automatically activate default selection mode; TRUE by default.

method.name: Display_1
method.description: Displays the object in this Context using default Display Mode. This will be the object's default display mode, if there is one. Otherwise, it will be the context mode. The Interactive Object's default selection mode is activated if GetAutoActivateSelection() is TRUE. In general, this is 0.

method.name: Display_2
method.description: Sets status, display mode and selection mode for specified Object If theSelectionMode equals -1, theIObj will not be activated: it will be displayed but will not be selectable.

method.name: Load_1
method.description: Allows you to load the Interactive Object with a given selection mode, and/or with the desired decomposition option, whether the object is visualized or not. The loaded objects will be selectable but displayable in highlighting only when detected by the Selector.

method.name: Erase
method.description: Hides the object. The object's presentations are simply flagged as invisible and therefore excluded from redrawing. To show hidden objects, use Display().

method.name: EraseAll
method.description: Hides all objects. The object's presentations are simply flagged as invisible and therefore excluded from redrawing. To show all hidden objects, use DisplayAll().

method.name: DisplayAll
method.description: Displays all hidden objects.

method.name: EraseSelected
method.description: Hides selected objects. The object's presentations are simply flagged as invisible and therefore excluded from redrawing. To show hidden objects, use Display().

method.name: DisplaySelected
method.description: Displays current objects.

method.name: ClearPrs
method.description: Empties the graphic presentation of the mode indexed by aMode. Warning! Removes theIObj. theIObj is still active if it was previously activated.

method.name: Remove
method.description: Removes Object from every viewer.

method.name: RemoveAll
method.description: Removes all the objects from Context.

method.name: Redisplay_1
method.description: Recomputes the seen parts presentation of the Object. If theAllModes equals true, all presentations are present in the object even if unseen.

method.name: Redisplay_2
method.description: Recomputes the Prs/Selection of displayed objects of a given type and a given signature. if signature = -1 doesn't take signature criterion.

method.name: RecomputePrsOnly
method.description: Recomputes the displayed presentations, flags the others. Doesn't update presentations.

method.name: RecomputeSelectionOnly
method.description: Recomputes the active selections, flags the others. Doesn't update presentations.

method.name: Update
method.description: Updates displayed interactive object by checking and recomputing its flagged as "to be recomputed" presentation and selection structures. This method does not force any recomputation on its own. The method recomputes selections even if they are loaded without activation in particular selector.

method.name: HighlightStyle_2
method.description: Returns default highlight style settings (could be overridden by PrsMgr_PresentableObject).

method.name: SetHighlightStyle_2
method.description: Setup highlight style settings. Tip: it is better modifying existing style returned by method HighlightStyle() instead of creating a new Prs3d_Drawer to avoid unexpected results due misconfiguration.

method.name: HighlightStyle_1
method.description: Returns current dynamic highlight style settings corresponding to Prs3d_TypeOfHighlight_Dynamic. This is just a short-cut to HighlightStyle(Prs3d_TypeOfHighlight_Dynamic).

method.name: SetHighlightStyle_1
method.description: Setup the style of dynamic highlighting corrsponding to Prs3d_TypeOfHighlight_Selected. This is just a short-cut to SetHighlightStyle(Prs3d_TypeOfHighlight_Dynamic,theStyle).

method.name: SelectionStyle
method.description: Returns current selection style settings corrsponding to Prs3d_TypeOfHighlight_Selected. This is just a short-cut to HighlightStyle(Prs3d_TypeOfHighlight_Selected).

method.name: SetSelectionStyle
method.description: Setup the style of selection highlighting. This is just a short-cut to SetHighlightStyle(Prs3d_TypeOfHighlight_Selected,theStyle).

method.name: HighlightStyle_3
method.description: Returns highlight style of the object if it is marked as highlighted via global status

method.name: HighlightStyle_4
method.description: Returns highlight style of the owner if it is selected

method.name: IsHilighted_1
method.description: Returns true if the object is marked as highlighted via its global status

method.name: IsHilighted_2
method.description: Returns true if the owner is marked as selected

method.name: HilightWithColor
method.description: Changes the color of all the lines of the object in view.

method.name: Unhilight
method.description: Removes hilighting from the Object.

method.name: DisplayPriority
method.description: Returns the display priority of the Object.

method.name: SetDisplayPriority_1
method.description: Sets the display priority of the seen parts presentation of the Object.

method.name: GetZLayer
method.description: Get Z layer id set for displayed interactive object.

method.name: SetZLayer
method.description: Set Z layer id for interactive object. The Z layers can be used to display temporarily presentations of some object in front of the other objects in the scene. The ids for Z layers are generated by V3d_Viewer.

method.name: SetViewAffinity
method.description: Setup object visibility in specified view. Has no effect if object is not displayed in this context.

method.name: DisplayMode
method.description: Returns the Display Mode setting to be used by default.

method.name: SetDisplayMode_1
method.description: Sets the display mode of seen Interactive Objects (which have no overridden Display Mode).

method.name: SetDisplayMode_2
method.description: Sets the display mode of seen Interactive Objects. theMode provides the display mode index of the entity theIObj.

method.name: UnsetDisplayMode
method.description: Unsets the display mode of seen Interactive Objects.

method.name: SetLocation
method.description: Puts the location on the initial graphic representation and the selection for the Object.

method.name: ResetLocation
method.description: Puts the Object back into its initial position.

method.name: HasLocation
method.description: Returns true if the Object has a location.

method.name: Location
method.description: Returns the location of the Object.

method.name: SetTransformPersistence
method.description: Sets transform persistence.

method.name: SetPixelTolerance
method.description: Setup pixel tolerance for MoveTo() operation.

method.name: PixelTolerance
method.description: Returns the pixel tolerance, default is 2. Pixel Tolerance extends sensitivity within MoveTo() operation (picking by point) and can be adjusted by application based on user input precision (e.g. screen pixel density, input device precision, etc.).

method.name: SetSelectionSensitivity
method.description: Allows to manage sensitivity of a particular selection of interactive object theObject and changes previous sensitivity value of all sensitive entities in selection with theMode to the given theNewSensitivity.

method.name: LastActiveView
method.description: Returns last active View (argument of MoveTo()/Select() methods).

method.name: MoveTo_2
method.description: Relays mouse position in pixels theXPix and theYPix to the interactive context selectors. This is done by the view theView passing this position to the main viewer and updating it. If theToRedrawOnUpdate is set to false, callee should call RedrawImmediate() to highlight detected object.

method.name: MoveTo_1
method.description: Relays axis theAxis to the interactive context selectors. This is done by the view theView passing this axis to the main viewer and updating it. If theToRedrawOnUpdate is set to false, callee should call RedrawImmediate() to highlight detected object.

method.name: ClearDetected
method.description: Clears the list of entities detected by MoveTo() and resets dynamic highlighting.

method.name: HasDetected
method.description: Returns true if there is a mouse-detected entity in context.

method.name: DetectedOwner
method.description: Returns the owner of the detected sensitive primitive which is currently dynamically highlighted. WARNING! This method is irrelevant to InitDetected()/MoreDetected()/NextDetected().

method.name: DetectedInteractive
method.description: Returns the interactive objects last detected in context. In general this is just a wrapper for Handle(AIS_InteractiveObject)::DownCast(DetectedOwner()->Selectable()).

method.name: HasDetectedShape
method.description: Returns true if there is a detected shape in local context.

method.name: DetectedShape
method.description: Returns the shape detected in local context.

method.name: HilightNextDetected
method.description: If more than 1 object is detected by the selector, only the "best" owner is hilighted at the mouse position. This Method allows the user to hilight one after another the other detected entities. If The method select is called, the selected entity will be the hilighted one! WARNING: Loop Method. When all the detected entities have been hilighted, the next call will hilight the first one again.

method.name: HilightPreviousDetected
method.description: Same as previous methods in reverse direction.

method.name: InitDetected
method.description: Initialization for iteration through mouse-detected objects in interactive context or in local context if it is opened.

method.name: NextDetected
method.description: Gets next current object during iteration through mouse-detected interactive objects.

method.name: DetectedCurrentOwner
method.description: Returns the owner from detected list pointed by current iterator position. WARNING! This method is irrelevant to DetectedOwner() which returns last picked Owner regardless of iterator position!

method.name: AddSelect_1
method.description: Adds object in the selection.

method.name: AddSelect_2
method.description: Adds object in the selection.

method.name: SelectPolygon
method.description: Select everything found in the polygon defined by bounding polyline. Viewer should be explicitly redrawn after selection.

method.name: SelectDetected
method.description: Select and hilights the previous detected via AIS_InteractiveContext::MoveTo() method; unhilights the previous picked. Viewer should be explicitly redrawn after selection.

method.name: BoundingBoxOfSelection_2
method.description: Returns bounding box of selected objects.

method.name: Select_2
method.description: Sets list of owner selected/deselected using specified selection scheme.

method.name: FitSelected_2
method.description: Fits the view correspondingly to the bounds of selected objects. Infinite objects are ignored if infinite state of AIS_InteractiveObject is set to true.

method.name: FitSelected_1
method.description: Fits the view correspondingly to the bounds of selected objects. Infinite objects are ignored if infinite state of AIS_InteractiveObject is set to true.

method.name: ToHilightSelected
method.description: Return value specified whether selected object must be hilighted when mouse cursor is moved above it

method.name: SetToHilightSelected
method.description: Specify whether selected object must be hilighted when mouse cursor is moved above it (in MoveTo method). By default this value is false and selected object is not hilighted in this case.

method.name: AutomaticHilight
method.description: Returns true if the automatic highlight mode is active; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetAutomaticHilight
method.description: Sets the highlighting status of detected and selected entities. This function allows you to disconnect the automatic mode.

method.name: SetSelected_1
method.description: Unhighlights previously selected owners and marks them as not selected. Marks owner given as selected and highlights it. Performs selection filters check.

method.name: SetSelected_2
method.description: Puts the interactive object aniObj in the list of selected objects. Performs selection filters check.

method.name: AddOrRemoveSelected_1
method.description: Allows to highlight or unhighlight the owner given depending on its selection status

method.name: SetSelectedState
method.description: Updates Selected state of specified owner without calling HilightSelected(). Has no effect if Selected state is not changed, and redirects to AddOrRemoveSelected() otherwise.

method.name: HilightSelected
method.description: Highlights selected objects.

method.name: UnhilightSelected
method.description: Removes highlighting from selected objects.

method.name: UpdateSelected
method.description: Updates the list of selected objects: i.e. highlights the newly selected ones and unhighlights previously selected objects.

method.name: ClearSelected
method.description: Empties previous selected objects in order to get the selected objects detected by the selector using UpdateSelected.

method.name: AddOrRemoveSelected_2
method.description: Allows to highlight or unhighlight the owner given depending on its selection status

method.name: IsSelected_1
method.description: Returns true is the owner given is selected

method.name: IsSelected_2
method.description: Returns true is the object given is selected

method.name: FirstSelectedObject
method.description: Returns the first selected object in the list of current selected.

method.name: NbSelected
method.description: Count a number of selected entities using InitSelected()+MoreSelected()+NextSelected() iterator.

method.name: InitSelected
method.description: Initializes a scan of the selected objects.

method.name: MoreSelected
method.description: Returns true if there is another object found by the scan of the list of selected objects.

method.name: NextSelected
method.description: Continues the scan to the next object in the list of selected objects.

method.name: SelectedOwner
method.description: Returns the owner of the selected entity.

method.name: SelectedInteractive
method.description: Return Handle(AIS_InteractiveObject)::DownCast (SelectedOwner()->Selectable()).

method.name: HasSelectedShape
method.description: Returns TRUE if the interactive context has a shape selected.

method.name: SelectedShape
method.description: Returns the selected shape. Basically it is just a shape returned stored by StdSelect_BRepOwner with graphic transformation being applied:

method.name: HasApplicative
method.description: Returns SelectedInteractive()->HasOwner().

method.name: Applicative
method.description: Returns SelectedInteractive()->GetOwner().

method.name: BeginImmediateDraw
method.description: initializes the list of presentations to be displayed returns False if no local context is opened.

method.name: ImmediateAdd
method.description: returns True if <anIObj> has been stored in the list.

method.name: EndImmediateDraw_2
method.description: returns True if the immediate display has been done.

method.name: EndImmediateDraw_1
method.description: Uses the First Active View of Main Viewer! returns True if the immediate display has been done.

method.name: RedrawImmediate
method.description: Redraws immediate structures in all views of the viewer given taking into account its visibility.

method.name: SetSelectionModeActive
method.description: Activates or deactivates the selection mode for specified object. Has no effect if selection mode was already active/deactivated.

method.name: Activate_2
method.description: Activates the selection mode aMode whose index is given, for the given interactive entity anIobj.

method.name: Activate_1
method.description: Activates the given selection mode for the all displayed objects.

method.name: Deactivate_2
method.description: Deactivates all the activated selection modes of an object.

method.name: Deactivate_4
method.description: Deactivates all the activated selection modes of the interactive object anIobj with a given selection mode aMode.

method.name: Deactivate_3
method.description: Deactivates the given selection mode for all displayed objects.

method.name: Deactivate_1
method.description: Deactivates all the activated selection mode at all displayed objects.

method.name: ActivatedModes
method.description: Returns the list of activated selection modes.

method.name: FilterType
method.description: Returns the context selection filter type.

method.name: SetFilterType
method.description: Sets the context selection filter type. SelectMgr_TypeFilter_OR selection filter is used by default.

method.name: Filters
method.description: Returns the list of filters active in a local context.

method.name: GlobalFilter
method.description: Returns the context selection global context filter.

method.name: AddFilter
method.description: Allows you to add the filter.

method.name: RemoveFilter
method.description: Removes a filter from context.

method.name: RemoveFilters
method.description: Remove all filters from context.

method.name: PickingStrategy
method.description: Return picking strategy; SelectMgr_PickingStrategy_FirstAcceptable by default.

method.name: SetPickingStrategy
method.description: Setup picking strategy - which entities detected by picking line will be accepted, considering Selection Filters. By default (SelectMgr_PickingStrategy_FirstAcceptable), Selection Filters reduce the list of entities so that the context accepts topmost in remaining.

method.name: DefaultDrawer
method.description: Returns the default attribute manager. This contains all the color and line attributes which can be used by interactive objects which do not have their own attributes.

method.name: SetDefaultDrawer
method.description: Sets the default attribute manager; should be set at context creation time. Warning - this setter doesn't update links to the default drawer of already displayed objects!

method.name: CurrentViewer
method.description: Returns the current viewer.

method.name: UpdateCurrentViewer
method.description: Updates the current viewer.

method.name: DisplayedObjects_1
method.description: Returns the list of displayed objects of a particular Type WhichKind and Signature WhichSignature. By Default, WhichSignature equals -1. This means that there is a check on type only.

method.name: DisplayedObjects_2
method.description: gives the list of displayed objects of a particular Type and signature. by Default, <WhichSignature> = -1 means control only on <WhichKind>.

method.name: ErasedObjects_1
method.description: Returns the list theListOfIO of erased objects (hidden objects) particular Type WhichKind and Signature WhichSignature. By Default, WhichSignature equals 1. This means that there is a check on type only.

method.name: ErasedObjects_2
method.description: gives the list of erased objects (hidden objects) Type and signature by Default, <WhichSignature> = -1 means control only on <WhichKind>.

method.name: ObjectsByDisplayStatus_1
method.description: Returns the list theListOfIO of objects with indicated display status particular Type WhichKind and Signature WhichSignature. By Default, WhichSignature equals 1. This means that there is a check on type only.

method.name: ObjectsByDisplayStatus_2
method.description: gives the list of objects with indicated display status Type and signature by Default, <WhichSignature> = -1 means control only on <WhichKind>.

method.name: ObjectsInside
method.description: fills <aListOfIO> with objects of a particular Type and Signature with no consideration of display status. by Default, <WhichSignature> = -1 means control only on <WhichKind>. if <WhichKind> = AIS_KindOfInteractive_None and <WhichSignature> = -1, all the objects are put into the list.

method.name: RebuildSelectionStructs
method.description: Rebuilds 1st level of BVH selection forcibly

method.name: Disconnect
method.description: Disconnects theObjToDisconnect from theAssembly and removes dependent selection structures

method.name: ObjectsForView
method.description: Query objects visible or hidden in specified view due to affinity mask.

method.name: GravityPoint
method.description: Return rotation gravity point.

method.name: DisplayActiveSensitive_1
method.description: Visualization of sensitives - for debugging purposes!

method.name: ClearActiveSensitive
method.description: Clear visualization of sensitives.

method.name: DisplayActiveSensitive_2
method.description: Visualization of sensitives - for debugging purposes!

method.name: SetLocalAttributes
method.description: Sets the graphic attributes of the interactive object, such as visualization mode, color, and material.

method.name: UnsetLocalAttributes
method.description: Removes the settings for local attributes of the Object and returns to defaults.

method.name: SetCurrentFacingModel
method.description: change the current facing model apply on polygons for SetColor(), SetTransparency(), SetMaterial() methods default facing model is Aspect_TOFM_TWO_SIDE. This mean that attributes is applying both on the front and back face.

method.name: HasColor
method.description: Returns true if a view of the Interactive Object has color.

method.name: Color
method.description: Returns the color of the Object in the interactive context.

method.name: SetColor
method.description: Sets the color of the selected entity.

method.name: UnsetColor
method.description: Removes the color selection for the selected entity.

method.name: Width
method.description: Returns the width of the Interactive Object in the interactive context.

method.name: SetWidth
method.description: Sets the width of the Object.

method.name: UnsetWidth
method.description: Removes the width setting of the Object.

method.name: SetMaterial
method.description: Provides the type of material setting for the view of the Object.

method.name: UnsetMaterial
method.description: Removes the type of material setting for viewing the Object.

method.name: SetTransparency
method.description: Provides the transparency settings for viewing the Object. The transparency value aValue may be between 0.0, opaque, and 1.0, fully transparent.

method.name: UnsetTransparency
method.description: Removes the transparency settings for viewing the Object.

method.name: SetPolygonOffsets
method.description: Sets up polygon offsets for the given AIS_InteractiveObject. It simply calls AIS_InteractiveObject::SetPolygonOffsets().

method.name: HasPolygonOffsets
method.description: Simply calls AIS_InteractiveObject::HasPolygonOffsets().

method.name: PolygonOffsets
method.description: Retrieves current polygon offsets settings for Object.

method.name: SetTrihedronSize
method.description: Sets the size aSize of the trihedron. Is used to change the default value 100 mm for display of trihedra. Use of this function in one of your own interactive objects requires a call to the Compute function of the new class. This will recalculate the presentation for every trihedron displayed.

method.name: TrihedronSize
method.description: returns the current value of trihedron size.

method.name: SetPlaneSize_2
method.description: Sets the plane size defined by the length in the X direction XSize and that in the Y direction YSize.

method.name: SetPlaneSize_1
method.description: Sets the plane size aSize.

method.name: PlaneSize
method.description: Returns true if the length in the X direction XSize is the same as that in the Y direction YSize.

method.name: SetDeviationCoefficient_2
method.description: Sets the deviation coefficient theCoefficient. Drawings of curves or patches are made with respect to a maximal chordal deviation. A Deviation coefficient is used in the shading display mode. The shape is seen decomposed into triangles. These are used to calculate reflection of light from the surface of the object. The triangles are formed from chords of the curves in the shape. The deviation coefficient theCoefficient gives the highest value of the angle with which a chord can deviate from a tangent to a curve. If this limit is reached, a new triangle is begun. This deviation is absolute and is set through the method: SetMaximalChordialDeviation. The default value is 0.001. In drawing shapes, however, you are allowed to ask for a relative deviation. This deviation will be: SizeOfObject * DeviationCoefficient.

method.name: SetAngleAndDeviation
method.description: Calls the AIS_Shape SetAngleAndDeviation to set both Angle and Deviation coefficients

method.name: SetDeviationCoefficient_1
method.description: Sets the deviation coefficient theCoefficient. Drawings of curves or patches are made with respect to a maximal chordal deviation. A Deviation coefficient is used in the shading display mode. The shape is seen decomposed into triangles. These are used to calculate reflection of light from the surface of the object. The triangles are formed from chords of the curves in the shape. The deviation coefficient theCoefficient gives the highest value of the angle with which a chord can deviate from a tangent to a curve. If this limit is reached, a new triangle is begun. This deviation is absolute and is set through the method: SetMaximalChordialDeviation. The default value is 0.001. In drawing shapes, however, you are allowed to ask for a relative deviation. This deviation will be: SizeOfObject * DeviationCoefficient.

method.name: DeviationCoefficient
method.description: Returns the deviation coefficient. Drawings of curves or patches are made with respect to a maximal chordal deviation. A Deviation coefficient is used in the shading display mode. The shape is seen decomposed into triangles. These are used to calculate reflection of light from the surface of the object. The triangles are formed from chords of the curves in the shape. The deviation coefficient gives the highest value of the angle with which a chord can deviate from a tangent to a curve. If this limit is reached, a new triangle is begun. This deviation is absolute and is set through Prs3d_Drawer::SetMaximalChordialDeviation. The default value is 0.001. In drawing shapes, however, you are allowed to ask for a relative deviation. This deviation will be: SizeOfObject * DeviationCoefficient.

method.name: SetDeviationAngle_1
method.description: default 20 degrees

method.name: HiddenLineAspect
method.description: Initializes hidden line aspect in the default drawing tool, or Drawer. The default values are: Color: Quantity_NOC_YELLOW Type of line: Aspect_TOL_DASH Width: 1.

method.name: SetHiddenLineAspect
method.description: Sets the hidden line aspect anAspect. Aspect defines display attributes for hidden lines in HLR projections.

method.name: DrawHiddenLine
method.description: returns Standard_True if the hidden lines are to be drawn. By default the hidden lines are not drawn.

method.name: SetIsoNumber
method.description: Sets the number of U and V isoparameters displayed.

method.name: IsoNumber
method.description: Returns the number of U and V isoparameters displayed.

method.name: IsoOnPlane_2
method.description: Returns True if drawing isoparameters on planes is enabled.

method.name: IsoOnPlane_1
method.description: Returns True if drawing isoparameters on planes is enabled. if <forUIsos> = False,

method.name: IsoOnTriangulation_3
method.description: Enables or disables on-triangulation build for isolines for a particular object. In case if on-triangulation builder is disabled, default on-plane builder will compute isolines for the object given.

method.description: Enables or disables on-triangulation build for isolines for default drawer. In case if on-triangulation builder is disabled, default on-plane builder will compute isolines for the object given.

method.name: IsoOnTriangulation_1
method.description: Returns true if drawing isolines on triangulation algorithm is enabled.

method.name: Display_3
method.description: ! @name obsolete methods

method.name: Hilight
method.description: Updates the display in the viewer to take dynamic detection into account. On dynamic detection by the mouse cursor, sensitive primitives are highlighted. The highlight color of entities detected by mouse movement is white by default.

method.name: SetSelectedAspect
method.description: Sets the graphic basic aspect to the current presentation of ALL selected objects.

method.name: Select_4
method.description: Selects everything found in the bounding rectangle defined by the pixel minima and maxima, XPMin, YPMin, XPMax, and YPMax in the view. The objects detected are passed to the main viewer, which is then updated.

method.name: Select_3
method.description: polyline selection; clears the previous picked list

method.name: Select_1
method.description: Stores and hilights the previous detected; Unhilights the previous picked.

method.name: ShiftSelect_1
method.description: Adds the last detected to the list of previous picked. If the last detected was already declared as picked, removes it from the Picked List.

method.name: ShiftSelect_2
method.description: Adds the last detected to the list of previous picked. If the last detected was already declared as picked, removes it from the Picked List.

method.name: ShiftSelect_3
method.description: Rectangle of selection; adds new detected entities into the picked list, removes the detected entities that were already stored.

method.name: SetCurrentObject
method.description: Updates the view of the current object in open context. Objects selected when there is no open local context are called current objects; those selected in open local context, selected objects.

method.name: AddOrRemoveCurrentObject
method.description: Allows to add or remove the object given to the list of current and highlight/unhighlight it correspondingly. Is valid for global context only; for local context use method AddOrRemoveSelected. Since this method makes sense only for neutral point selection of a whole object, if 0 selection of the object is empty this method simply does nothing.

method.name: UpdateCurrent
method.description: Updates the list of current objects, i.e. hilights new current objects, removes hilighting from former current objects. Objects selected when there is no open local context are called current objects; those selected in open local context, selected objects.

method.name: IsCurrent
method.description: Returns true if there is a non-null interactive object in Neutral Point. Objects selected when there is no open local context are called current objects; those selected in open local context, selected objects.

method.name: InitCurrent
method.description: Initializes a scan of the current selected objects in Neutral Point. Objects selected when there is no open local context are called current objects; those selected in open local context, selected objects.

method.name: MoreCurrent
method.description: Returns true if there is another object found by the scan of the list of current objects. Objects selected when there is no open local context are called current objects; those selected in open local context, selected objects.

method.name: NextCurrent
method.description: Continues the scan to the next object in the list of current objects. Objects selected when there is no open local context are called current objects; those selected in open local context, selected objects.

method.name: Current
method.description: Returns the current interactive object. Objects selected when there is no open local context are called current objects; those selected in open local context, selected objects.

method.name: HilightCurrents
method.description: Highlights current objects. Objects selected when there is no open local context are called current objects; those selected in open local context, selected objects.

method.name: UnhilightCurrents
method.description: Removes highlighting from current objects. Objects selected when there is no open local context are called current objects; those selected in open local context, selected objects.

method.name: ClearCurrents
method.description: Empties previous current objects in order to get the current objects detected by the selector using UpdateCurrent. Objects selected when there is no open local context are called current objects; those selected in open local context, selected objects.

method.name: DetectedCurrentShape
method.description: Returns current mouse-detected shape or empty (null) shape, if current interactive object is not a shape (AIS_Shape) or there is no current mouse-detected interactive object at all. DetectedCurrentOwner(), InitDetected(), MoreDetected(), NextDetected().

method.name: DetectedCurrentObject
method.description: Returns current mouse-detected interactive object or null object, if there is no currently detected interactives DetectedCurrentOwner(), InitDetected(), MoreDetected(), NextDetected().

method.name: SubIntensityColor
method.description: Sub-intensity allows temporary highlighting of particular objects with specified color in a manner of selection highlight, but without actual selection (e.g., global status and owner's selection state will not be updated). The method returns the color of such highlighting. By default, it is Quantity_NOC_GRAY40.

method.name: SetSubIntensityColor
method.description: Sub-intensity allows temporary highlighting of particular objects with specified color in a manner of selection highlight, but without actual selection (e.g., global status and owner's selection state will not be updated). The method sets up the color for such highlighting. By default, this is Quantity_NOC_GRAY40.

method.name: SubIntensityOn
method.description: Highlights, and removes highlights from, the displayed object which is displayed at Neutral Point with subintensity color. Available only for active local context. There is no effect if there is no local context. If a local context is open, the presentation of the Interactive Object activates the selection mode.

method.name: SubIntensityOff
method.description: Removes the subintensity option for the entity. If a local context is open, the presentation of the Interactive Object activates the selection mode.

method.name: Selection
method.description: Returns selection instance

method.name: SetSelection
method.description: Sets selection instance to manipulate a container of selected owners

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
